BiblicalUsage: Jeremai is an Israelite, a son of Hashum who had taken a strange wife. In Ezra 10:33, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jeremai belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
